'''Bubbling mead''' is a throwable [[mead]]: a splash potion of {{EffectLink|Speed}} II lasting 5 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/bubbling_mead.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A honey bottle, a brown mushroom, 2 sugar and sweet berries, an apple or glow berries. Picking up a honey bottle unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Throwing ===
It can't be eaten. Like a splash potion, it is thrown and applies Speed II (+40% speed) for up to 5:00 to every creature in the splash, at full duration for a direct hit and shorter further out. The tooltip marks it as throwable.
